This vignette demonstrates the callout helpers in myquarto.

## Setup

```{r}
library(myquarto)
```

## Add Expand/Collapse Controls

```{r, results = 'asis'}
render_callout_ui(
  description = "Use the buttons below to expand or collapse all callout sections.",
  button_expand_label = "Expand Sections",
  button_collapse_label = "Collapse Sections"
)
```

## Render Mixed Content in Callouts

```{r, results = 'asis'}
content_items <- list(
  "This section is plain Markdown content.\n\n- Item A\n- Item B",
  head(mtcars, 5),
  "Final notes with **bold text** and `inline code`."
)

render_callout_content(
  content_list = content_items,
  titles = c("Overview", "Data Preview", "Notes"),
  callout_type = "tip",
  collapse = TRUE
)
```

## Auto Titles

If titles are omitted, section names are generated automatically.

```{r, results = 'asis'}
render_callout_content(
  content_list = list(
    "First section content",
    "Second section content"
  )
)
```

## Title Rule

Titles must be unique. Duplicate titles raise an error.
